name: OrderArrows - The Only Row
description: A collection holding exactly one entry, the only state where both arrows are dead at once. Real rather than contrived: a site adds its first hero slide or sponsor level before it has a second, and that collection is ordered from the moment it exists. The row still gets arrows because it is still a sequence. Captured separately because the top and bottom rows each prove only one direction disables, so a bug in the is-there-anywhere-to-move rule that got one end right would look correct in both and show only here.
